lines: Kuroki Shizuku pursued me tenaciously,
and Taimanin Library chased after him.
In the meantimeー
Sakura
I caught something!
Shouts of joy echoed in the valley.
The rod bent like a bow.
And a fish with brightly red spots jumped as if to dance across the water's surface.
Clear
Big!!!
Yata
Its full length looked more than 30 centimeters.
Both Clear's and Yata's eyes lit up.
Sakura
It's a landlocked salmon! Look, Fuma, look! I caught the king of the river!
Sakura proudly held up the landlocked salmon she'd just caught. However...
Sakura
Huh?
Clear
Fuma, gone?
Yata
There was no trace of me in their surroundings.
The freeloader trio tilted their heads in confusion.
Me
Heh-heh-heh♪ Time to play some "Sekironin" while Sakura's playing at the river!
I was on my way home by myself.
After all, I had trained with Library in the morning, and then walked all the way to Ascetic's Valley on top of that.
I couldn't keep up with those three, so overexcited to play at the river that they could start dancing about.
I also swam a bit out of nostalgia, but of course I'd gotten tired soon after.
But Sakura went on like, "I still wanna play!" so I decided to pretend to just rest while waiting for an opportunity to sneak back home.
It might have been a bad idea to let Sakura walk outside alone, but she could hide in Clear or Yata's shadow on her way home.
Me
"Sekironin" is mine until tomorrow!
That was the promise. I'd lost a bet and Sakura had the right to play it first.
I had to play it as much as possible to get better.
Me
Fu-, Fu-, Fu～～ma♪ A～rca～～de Fu～～ma～～♪
My legs ached from the round trip to Ascetic's Valley, but "Sekironin" was waiting for me.
I couldn't help but hum a tune.
Me
Hm?
Suddenly feeling as if someone was watching me, I stopped in my tracks.
I scanned the area.
I was in a terraced rice field district.
But it was strangely silent.
Even the sounds of insects coudn't be heard.
Me
Maybe it's just my imagination?
And just as I was about to start walking again...
*Rustle.*
The shade of the grass rustled behind me.
And I saw someone's shadow.
Wh-Whose!?
Waghh!!!
Just when I thought something was behind me, a loud voice rang near my ear.
Me
Bwaghh!!
Startled, I reflexively jumped away to the side.
Right into the ridge of a rice paddy.
It was sloping down into the watery field as if asking me to fall in.
Naturally, my feet got tangled...
Me
Huh!? Wai-! Whoa, whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa!
*Roll-rollーsplaaaash!!*
...and I magnificently tumbled into the mud of the rice paddy.
Yukikaze
Ahahahahahahaha! How are you so～ clumsy!?
Looking down at me covered in mud was Yukikaze, bursting with laughter.
Me
B-Because you scared me out of nowhere!
Yukikaze
So bad that you fell over!? Pffft... Really? Aren't you a Taimanin?
Me
Urgh... I'm exhausted, a lot's been going on today!
I picked up my mud-caked body and crawled little by little back onto the main road.
I was covered head to toe in mud. My hair was a sticky mess.
I scraped the mud from my cheeks with my hands and tossed it aside, but it was no use.
Yukikaze
Eww, what, a mess. So～ dirty!
Despite being the perpetrator herself, Yukikaze gave an exaggerated frown.
Me
Dammit, what do I do now? Tokiko will rip into me good over this.
I couldn't tell her that it was because I'd been scared by Yukikaze.
That's the exact kind of thing that would bring her wrath down on me, asking, "And you call yourself a Taimanin?"
Even if I fooled her into thinking I was just a little careless, I'd still likely be handed a washbasin and told, "Then better start scrubbing those clothes."
Yukikaze
Sorry, sorry. Come on, I'll wash them for you at my place.
Perhaps feeling a little bad, Yukikaze uncharacteristically apologized as she gave the suggestion.
Me
You'll hand wash them?
Yukikaze
Why would I? We're using the washing machine obviously. I'll have the old man do it.
Me
The last thing I want is to be attacked by him again.
Yukikaze
You'll be fine if you're with me. Besides, I bought a new fighting game so let's play together.
With that, Yukikaze walked off without waiting for my reply.
Me
A new fighting game, don't tell me it's...
It was frustrating, but my feet seemed to have a will of their own as they followed after Yukikaze.
Yukikaze turned to look back at me, chuckled, and spoke boastfully.
Yukikaze
They re-released "Samurai Strikers." Sam-Strike's back!!
Me
Whooaa!!
Yukikaze
And plus, it's the arcade cabinet version. *Smirk*
Me
For real!? What are you, a billionaire?! Let's go, let's go!!!
I started running, my muddy shoes making a gooey sound.
Yukikaze
Ugh, gross. You're splashing mud on me, Fuma! It's getting on my clothes too!!
Me
Then just wash it off! Go, go, go!!
Yukikaze
Wai-, stop, don't get so close!
I, covered in mud, and the fleeing Yukikaze, both kept running toward her mansion.
Meanwhile, Taimanin Library was in the Gosha Forest.
This area was particularly dense with woods and awfully dark even in the daytime.
The way he walked, barely shaking the undergrowth and going unnoticed by wild beasts, was the very picture of a skilled shinobi.
Library
(Hmmm...)
With his cyborg sensors, as well as his sixth sense that remained from when he was human, Library was precisely tracking Kuroki Shizuku's trail.
By concealing his body in the substance (?) called "Drops of Darkness," the boy would abruptly appear and disappear, or block attacks,
but it didn't seem to mean that he could freely move while he was cloaked in them.
As evidence of that, there was a trail of footprints, albeit every dozen meters.
Judging from the depressions in the ground, he was probably repeatedly leaping and landing whenever he momentarily reappeared.
Using them as a guide, Library continued his pursuit, until the footprints suddenly came to an end.
No, it only appeared to have come to an end.
Library
(So you're backtracking, huh.)
Since a short while ago the footprints had been changing.
Although Shizuku had done well trying to hide it, the footprints had become deeper, and there had been signs that he'd stepped on the same spot twice.
Just like when a wild animal attempts to confuse potential predators, they start walking back over their steps,
then, after a certain distance, they take a large leap off to the side.
When it does, its pursuer is deceived into thinking the trail has suddenly disappeared.
It's used by rabbits and foxes to escape from hunters, or conversely by brown bears to attack their hunters from behind.
Of course, in this case it was the latter.
Knowing full well of Shizuku's intention, Library was pretending to be fooled.
If he did so, the attack would eventually come. And he would also know its exact timing.
It would be where the trail disappeared, or in other words, here.
Library
Looks like you've decided to stand your ground.
Library raised his voice.
There was no response.
But he silently waited.
After a short while, Shizuku's irritated voice could be heard.
Shizuku
『You really are a hassle, mister! What's so fun about swearing your allegiance to your master Diot!?』
Library
Boy, what makes a master of shinobi isー
Shizuku
『Yeah, yeah, their capacity to lead. I heard that before!』
Library
Indeed so.
Library nodded in agreement, then spoke as if something just occurred to him.
Library
Can I tell you one thing?
Shizuku
『What is it?』
Library
It's better to take a large stride when backtracking. Then, when you go backward, you should walk between the footsteps instead of stepping on the previous ones.
Library
This way, your footprints won't overlap, and the chances of being noticed by the enemy will lessen.
Library
It's good to borrow the wisdom of the beast, but you'll be detected instantly doing it that way. It's essential to use your human intellect as well.
Shizuku's voice cried out in a tantrum.
Shizuku
『Oh, for theー just shut up already!! You think you're my teacher or something, old man!?』
Library
That's what elders do. We can't help but want to give harsh yet honest advice because we feel as if we're watching our younger selves.
Shizuku
『It's none of your concern!! Just because you noticed my backtracking doesn't mean anything!!』
Shizuku
『This is where your dumb luck runs out, old man! I chose the battlefield and caught you in my trap. I realized this forest is full of Animal Taimanin!』
Shizuku
『So I can use another ability of my "Drops of Darkness."』
Library
Oh? And what ability is that?
Shizuku
『I put the "Drops of Darkness" inside lesser animals' bodies and control them! Like this!』
Dark Shinobi Bear
*Grrrrrraaaaaaawr!!*
Dark Shinobi Snake
*Hiss, hiss, hissssssss!!*
Several Animal Taimanin appeared to encircle Library as they let out their war cries.
Their bodies had changed color as if they'd been permeated with darkness, and their ferocity seemed to be increasing as well.
And leading them, the form of Shizuku came into view.
Shizuku
You're all alone, old man. The tables have turned.
Library
Have they now?
At last, the Taimanin Library and Kuroki Shizuku were about to clash.
